tasks.short: Design electro-optical sensing or imaging systems

steps.what: Define actual electro-optical sensing or imaging requirements, scene/target conditions and interface constraints
inputs: actual application, target/scene characteristics and operating conditions
actual spectral, resolution, sensitivity and interface requirements
outputs: engineer-defined sensing/imaging requirements and assumptions

steps.what: Design electro-optical sensing or imaging systems, selecting optical path, detector, illumination and signal/interface architecture
inputs: engineer-defined sensing/imaging requirements and assumptions
actual component characteristics and operating constraints
outputs: engineer-selected electro-optical architecture and component choices

steps.what: Author actual electro-optical model and layout in optical design/analysis software (OPS_SYSTEM), entering real component, scene and tolerance parameters
inputs: engineer-selected electro-optical architecture and component choices
engineer-entered actual geometry, component properties and scene assumptions
outputs: complete electro-optical layout/model and analysis results

steps.what: Check the completed sensing/imaging design, model assumptions and performance against actual requirements and intended internal revision
inputs: complete electro-optical layout/model and analysis results
actual requirements and component evidence
outputs: exact checked electro-optical design and internal revision destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked electro-optical design as its intended internal revision
inputs: exact checked electro-optical design and internal revision destination
outputs: saved internal sensing/imaging design

tasks.design: Configure reusable component properties and analysis setup profiles in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the optical design/analysis system. The engineer defines the scene and system architecture, enters actual parameters, checks the completed design and saves the exact internal revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated optical component and analysis setup adds model-entry effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native optical design profiles can reuse known component properties and setup structure.
tasks.still_hard: Actual scenes, noise, tolerances and component limits determine whether the design works.
tasks.human_edge: Select defensible architecture and challenge simulation assumptions.

ambition.what: No autonomous design release or claim of newly achieved performance.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; optical design owner validates property/profile reuse

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native optical model profiles can reduce repeated setup while application-specific architecture and performance checks remain engineering work.

assumptions: Unmeasured repeated-setup scenario. Gross 30 x .10 = 3; upkeep 1; net 2 hours per 100.
Engineer produces actual scene assumptions, geometry and component properties in s1-s3; absent data requires manual investigation, not inferred parameters.
Existing optical solver/runtime already happens today and earns no saving. Gain applies only to presently repeated setup work.

Same-system save 1 is fully retained and earns no saving. Final complete-design check s4 gates exact version/destination; edits invalidate check. No physical energisation or manufacturing release is promised.
unknowns: Existing reusable optical setup and actual repeated entry
research_questions: Which recurring setup operations survive checking actual scene and component assumptions?

already_counted.description: Requirements, architecture and completed design verification

incremental.description: Maintain and validate optical property/setup profiles

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed electro-optical design and internal revision checked in s4; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 native setup scenario below 2% modeled net; no automatic architecture or solver benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve and reconcile actual photonics design objectives, revision history, issue records and analysis/test outcomes in engineering document control (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual design revisions and existing engineer-authored issue/decision records
actual analysis/test records with run identities
outputs: engineer-reviewed source records and unresolved design-history gaps

steps.what: Determine the actual design-process objectives, issues, decisions and outcomes that the documentation must explain
inputs: engineer-reviewed source records and unresolved design-history gaps
engineer's actual design knowledge and purpose of the document
outputs: engineer-authored account outline with supported design-process conclusions

steps.what: Document photonics system or component design processes, drafting the objectives, issues and outcomes with links to actual evidence
inputs: engineer-authored account outline with supported design-process conclusions
engineer-reviewed actual source records
outputs: complete source-linked photonics design-process narrative

loop.purpose: Draft narrative explanations of actual design-process evidence
loop.input: Exact design revisions, source records and engineer-authored account outline
loop.output: Candidate narrative with per-claim evidence references and explicit gaps
loop.check: Engineer checks sequence, meaning, every claimed cause/outcome and all numbers against records in s4
loop.stop: Missing evidence, contradictory revisions or two failed revisions stops drafting; engineer writes manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates and revision links handle fixed metadata first; explaining actual issues and outcomes requires prose meaning beyond field substitution

steps.what: Check and correct the complete design-process document, evidence links, objectives, issues, outcomes and intended record revision
inputs: complete source-linked photonics design-process narrative
actual source records and supported design-process conclusions
outputs: exact final checked process document and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked photonics design-process document to its intended internal revision
inputs: exact final checked process document and internal destination
outputs: saved internal design-process documentation

tasks.design: Configure source/revision views in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the engineering document-control system, and use native templates in {DOCS} before a bounded narrative-drafting loop. The engineer reconciles actual history, selects supported conclusions and checks the complete document before saving its exact internal revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Explaining the meaning of actual design history takes prose authoring beyond metadata collection.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can propose source-linked narrative for engineering correction.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible sequence or cause is not evidence of what happened in the design.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish documented outcomes from recollection and unsupported causal claims.

ambition.what: No autonomous publication or invention of missing design history.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; document owner authorizes source context and drafting scope

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded source-linked narrative drafting can assist engineering process documentation, with full factual and causal checking retained.

assumptions: Unmeasured existing-history documentation episode. Gross 30 x .05 + 34 x .15 = 6.6; upkeep 2; net 4.6 hours per 100.

Actual source producers already authored design/test records in their original work. Retrieval, gap reconciliation, account selection and any actual recollection capture remain in s1-s2; no new structured decision log assumed free.
Native metadata templates are used first. No LLM arithmetic or inferred missing objectives, issues or outcomes; gaps remain explicit for manual resolution.

Documentation is saved internally, with no external send promised. Same-system save 1 is fully retained with no saving. Final full-document check s4 gates exact version/destination; edits require recheck.
unknowns: Actual source completeness and correction burden
research_questions: Does the narrative aid reduce total writing/checking effort without adding unsupported causal claims?

already_counted.description: Source reconciliation, account selection, narrative review and final factual correction

incremental.description: Maintain permitted source context, narrative checks and evaluation cases

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed design-process document, evidence and internal destination checked in s4; edits invalidate check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 bounded writing scenario below 4.6% modeled net; source gaps may erase gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design photonics products for energy efficiency

steps.what: Establish actual energy-efficiency objectives, output requirements, operating conditions and evidence for the selected light-source product
inputs: actual light-source application and energy/output requirements
actual component efficiency, thermal and optical evidence
outputs: engineer-defined energy/performance requirements and evidence limits

steps.what: Design photonics products such as light sources to achieve increased energy efficiency, balancing optical, electrical and thermal choices
inputs: engineer-defined energy/performance requirements and evidence limits
actual component and integration constraints
outputs: engineer-selected light-source design and energy-efficiency hypotheses

steps.what: Author the actual light-source design model and efficiency analysis setup in photonics engineering software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: engineer-selected light-source design and energy-efficiency hypotheses
engineer-entered geometry, electrical power, optical and thermal parameters
outputs: complete light-source model and calculated energy/performance results

steps.what: Check the complete product design and energy analysis, losses, assumptions and actual output requirements against the intended internal revision
inputs: complete light-source model and calculated energy/performance results
actual requirements and component evidence
outputs: exact checked light-source design and internal revision destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked light-source product design as its intended internal revision
inputs: exact checked light-source design and internal revision destination
outputs: saved internal light-source design

tasks.design: For the light-source product route, configure reusable component/property and analysis setup profiles in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the photonics engineering system. The engineer chooses optical/electrical/thermal design, supplies actual parameters and checks the complete energy/performance analysis before saving the internal revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated model setup can distract from efficiency trade-offs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable analysis profiles can reduce repeated parameter-layout work.
tasks.still_hard: Energy efficiency depends on actual operating points and coupled losses, not a plausible design description.
tasks.human_edge: Balance real output needs and efficiency without hiding thermal or integration costs.

ambition.what: No claimed efficiency increase without physical evidence.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; photonics analysis owner validates profiles and source access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reusable engineering analysis setup can reduce repeated entry, while product energy-efficiency decisions require validated operating assumptions.

assumptions: Unmeasured light-source design episode, one stated product alternative. Gross 24 x .10 = 2.4; upkeep .75; net 1.65 hours per 100.
Engineer produces actual component evidence, geometry and power/thermal parameters in s1-s3. No free measured loss table or inferred efficiency values.
Existing numerical calculations and solver/runtime already occur today and earn no additional saving. Only repeated setup changes.

Same-system save 1 remains fully retained with no saving. Completed design check s4 gates exact internal version and destination; edits require recheck. No manufacturing release or physical energisation is promised.
unknowns: Actual reuse beyond current engineering tools
research_questions: Which model setup is still repeated after existing profiles, and which assumptions need new measurements?

already_counted.description: Requirements, energy trade-offs and complete design verification

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed light-source design and energy analysis/destination checked in s4; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 repeated-setup scenario below 1.65% modeled net; no unmeasured energy-performance claim.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare the actual personnel training session using current photonics equipment instructions, learning objectives and supervised practice needs
inputs: actual trainee roles and training needs
existing approved current equipment instructions and practice criteria
outputs: engineer-prepared training session and actual practice criteria

steps.what: Train operators, engineers or other personnel through live explanation, demonstration and questions on the actual photonics procedure
inputs: engineer-prepared training session and actual practice criteria
actual trainee questions and understanding
outputs: delivered training and trainee understanding to assess

steps.what: Observe supervised trainee practice in the authorised training setup, give feedback and assess actual completion against the session criteria
inputs: delivered training and trainee understanding to assess
actual trainee practice and practice criteria
outputs: engineer's actual per-trainee completion and follow-up findings

steps.what: Enter and check actual training completion and follow-up findings for the correct trainees and course revision
inputs: engineer's actual per-trainee completion and follow-up findings
actual roster, session and course identifiers
outputs: exact checked completion entries and trainee/course destinations

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual training completion entries after live training and practice assessment
inputs: exact checked completion entries and trainee/course destinations
outputs: saved actual training completion/follow-up records

tasks.design: Configure current instruction links and roster/course identifiers in {LMS}, reading actual equipment instructions from {OPS_SYSTEM}, the photonics engineering record system. The engineer delivers training, observes practice, determines actual completion and checks the final entries before saving them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated instruction lookup and fixed roster entry add training administration.
tasks.enabler_now: Native course links and roster-context fields can reduce navigation and repeated identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding, safe practice and actual competence require observation and feedback.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt teaching and recognise incomplete competence.

ambition.what: No automatic certification or reduction in live practice.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; training/equipment owners validate access and course mapping

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native learning-system roster/context fields can reduce clerical work while training and competence assessment remain human.

assumptions: Unmeasured locally documented training episode. Gross 15 x .10 + 9 x .10 = 2.4; upkeep .75; net 1.65 hours per 100.

Existing approved instruction has its engineering owner; engineer prepares the session in s1 and produces completion findings only after s2-s3. No new structured competence data or pre-event completion notice assumed free.

Only lookup/fixed identifiers change; substantive completion judgment and entries remain human. Training uses the already authorised training setup; no new production machine operation or deployment is proposed.

Same-system save 1 earns no saving and stays fully retained. s4 checks the actual completed entries and correct recipients/records after practice; edits invalidate gate. No automatic notification or certification send is promised.
unknowns: Actual roster re-entry and local training-record requirement
research_questions: Which existing roster fields are retyped after completed observed practice?

already_counted.description: Live teaching, practice assessment and actual completion entry/check

incremental.description: Maintain course links and verify roster/course mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual completion entries, trainees and course/session revision checked in s4 after s2-s3; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 native training-administration scenario below 1.65% modeled net; live teaching and assessment retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Write source-linked design accounts without unsupported causes
Record training completion after observed practice
role.ambitious_version: Use verified native optical design profiles and source-linked documentation aids while engineers retain architecture, energy trade-offs, factual interpretation and real trainee assessment.
